title: Qualifying monthly groups
brief: Filter completed groups rather than individual transactions.
instructions: Group paid UTC 2024 transaction revenue by month and category identity. Keep totals at least 100.00; do not introduce empty groups.

A paid order is an order whose own status is 'paid'; the payments table carries a separate status that these challenges never ask about. For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving qualifying monthly groups.

hints.text: Join items to products, group by UTC month and category identity, then apply the threshold.
January category 2 reaches 100 through several smaller lines.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT sum(i.qty * i.unit_price)::VARCHAR || '/' || count(*)::VARCHAR FROM order_items i JOIN products p USING (product_id) JOIN orders o USING (order_id) WHERE p.category_id = 2 AND o.status = 'paid' AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-02-01 00:00:00+00'
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: January category 2 reaches 100 across three lines
